title: Return in output for cortex CLI commands
description:
Currently when specifying a cortex CLI command via the cortex.yml file, you specify the command, the description, and the timeout.

This doesn't provide enough functionality and configurability because it does not allow text to be output upon the command being successfully run.

Modify the cortex CLI infrastructure such that an optional success text can be specified, which will be output into standard output upon successfully running the configured command.
